messages:
rebecca: hey all — noticed the console heatmap showing repeated bursts where the embeddings endpoint rejects or routes to the slow fallback when requests contain mixed dims. screenshot: https://stash/redwood/heatmap/shot.png 

omar: saw that too earlier. i think it lines up with prefetch being off. router seems to treat the incoming header as advisory so it picks shard-A then falls back. header we get in logs: `X-Embed-Dims: [768,1024]`

rebecca: dug into telemetry: `embed.route.choice` reasons show `capacity_estimate` for ~70% of these, and `embed.prefetch.matched` = false. query i ran: `sum by(tenant) (rate(embed_prefetch_miss_total[5m]))` — top tenant has a spike during 12:05-12:12

lisa: @rebecca can we surface per-tenant heatmaps in the Console rollout UX? customers will demand visibility before we flip any routing behavior changes.

rebecca: proposal: 1) add Console toggle `Enable prefetch heatmap` behind feature flag `enable_prefetch_heatmap` (start 10% tenants) 2) emit event `embed.prefetch.heatmap_view` when toggled 3) change router to treat preflight header as a stronger hint for same-tenant requests (not full hard-binding, but prefer same-shard if resources allow)

omar: i like it. suggest we also add metrics `embed.routing.fallback_latency_p50` and `embed.routing.fallback_rate` so the alerting can catch regressions. alert rule idea: `p50 > 300ms for 5m => page oncall`

rebecca: sample feature flag rollout command: `rctl ff set enable_prefetch_heatmap --percent=10 --team=eng-platform` and event tracking: `track_event('embed.prefetch.toggle', {tenant, enabled})`

deploy-bot: canary deploy for router change completed on eng-canary-2 :white_check_mark: logs: https://ci.redwood/deploy/9423

omar: once canary is stable, i'll wire the new metrics to the Console dashboard. also adding a small preflight acceptance test in e2e that sends mixed dims and asserts no 413s when prefetch hint present.

rebecca: ok i'll open the PR with runbook and docs links. tagging @lisa for UX copy. thanks — i'll ping once the flag is live.
